name: Kubernetes
author: McSparrow <support@mcsparrow.eu>
description: Manage Kubernetes clusters from McHarbor: pods, deployments and other workloads, services and networking, storage, config, namespaces, nodes and events — with pod logs, deployment scaling and rolling restarts. Cluster connections are owned by the plugin and their kubeconfig and bearer-token credentials are encrypted at rest with the host's own key.
